title: Nandini Dutta evicted from Bigg Boss Bangla 3 as Sourav Ganguly calls out her conduct

 Screen Nandini Dutta evicted from Bigg Boss Bangla 3 as Sourav Ganguly calls out her conduct
 By Sanjali Brahma 
 Published: 8 Nov 2026, 9:00AM | 2 min read Rajveer and Nandini inside the Bigg Boss Bangla house 
 Advertisement Nandini Dutta has been evicted from the Bigg Boss Bangla Season 3 house following repeated physical altercations with fellow contestant Rajveer Dey. The decision was announced during the show's special Dadar Darbar episode on Saturday, November 7, with host Sourav Ganguly reprimanding the actress over her behaviour.
 Tensions between Nandini and Rajveer had been escalating throughout the week, with their arguments repeatedly turning physical. During one such confrontation, Nandini was seen repeatedly slapping Rajveer during a heated exchange. The argument reportedly stemmed from Nandini's displeasure with Rajveer for not taking her side during her disagreement with fellow contestant Srijla Guha following the vampire and human luxury budget task.
 As the argument intensified, Nandini continued hitting Rajveer. Initially, he attempted to manage the situation, but eventually pushed her away to create some distance. However, Nandini moved towards him again, prompting Rajveer to push her away once more. The confrontation took another turn when Rajveer, visibly distressed and angry, began slapping himself repeatedly on the cheeks. He also firmly told Nandini not to touch him again, warning that if a similar situation arose, he would continue to hurt himself. He eventually walked away from the argument.
 Advertisement The incident became a major point of discussion during the Dadar Darbar special, where host Sourav Ganguly confronted Nandini over her conduct. Reminding her of the rules of the Bigg Boss house, Ganguly said that physical violence, slapping and pushing were unacceptable. He also questioned why she had behaved that way towards Rajveer, pointing out that the latter had not done anything over the preceding two days to warrant such treatment.
 View this post on Instagram 
 Advertisement 
 Expressing his disappointment, Ganguly further remarked that had a male contestant, such as Sourav or Durnibar, behaved similarly, he would have asked Bigg Boss to remove him immediately and send him back to Kolkata by train. Nandini became emotional and admitted that her actions were unforgivable, seeking another opportunity. However, Ganguly maintained that she had already been given a chance and that her behaviour could not be overlooked.
 He eventually instructed her to leave the house, telling her, 'Your time has come to leave the fort. You can leave now.' Despite the eviction announcement, Rajveer attempted to stand by Nandini, saying that he did not want to lose their relationship. He eventually accepted the show's decision, adding that she would learn from the experience and that they would meet outside the house.
 This was Nandini's second exit from the main Bigg Boss Bangla 3  house. She had previously been announced as an evicted contestant following the audience voting process. However, instead of leaving the show, she was sent to the secret room and subsequently returned to the main house on Wednesday.
 Her return was followed by renewed tensions with Rajveer, culminating in the physical confrontation that eventually led to her eviction. Nandini's departure marks another significant development in the ongoing season.
